High Priority Issues (19)

1. Low Color Contrast 19
Description
Text or button elements must have sufficient color contrast to ensure readability for visually impaired users. The Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) recommend a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 for normal text.
